title: "DORA's ICT third-party rules in depth"
summary: "The detail behind DORA's supplier rules: a register of all ICT contracts in the templates of Implementing Regulation 2024/2956, filed yearly (Spain's CNMV took 2026 filings, dated 31 December 2025, in March), Article 30 terms with unrestricted audit rights, TLPT participation and exit plans for critical functions, and subcontracting rules in Delegated Regulation 2025/532."
